messages:
jordan: Quick sync: active/active fallback is currently routing GDPR-tagged tenants to us-east when eu-west hits burst. Legal flagged this as unacceptable for some customers. Need a pragmatic mode we can ship fast.

ash: Options quick list:
  - DENY: proxy returns 409.residency.denied
  - ESCROW: accept at edge (eu) into escrow queue, return 202 + ticket id, mirror later
  - TAG+AUDIT: allow but emit immutable audit event + alerting

marta: Ops: escrow is most work (queues, TTLs, storage watermarks). DENY simpler but impacts availability. TAG+AUDIT lowest infra but legal hates it.

jordan: What about exposing policy per-tenant + per-request override? e.g., tenant.residency_policy = STRICT|ESCROW|AUDIT and header `X-Residence-Policy` to opt-in if tenant permits.

ash: Implementation sketch: proxy checks tenant policy, if ESCROW -> enqueue to eu-escrow service and return `202.residency.escrow; ticket=<hex>`; record metric `escrow.queue_len` and `residency.fallback_count`. If STRICT -> 409 with body {code: "residency.strict_denied", msg: "write rejected due to residency"}.

ops-bot: alert: region eu-west fallback_ratio=0.012 (5m) -> prewarm pools and page on-call.

marta: Read contract note: for escrowed keys return last-committed value + header `X-Residency-Ticket` when pending, or `403.residency.read_denied` for strict. Also add ticket-age dashboard.

security: For escrow audit we should sign enqueue records with HSM key and persist payload-hash + signer, so we can prove receive-in-eu.

jordan: Action items: (1) add tenant policy + header (ash) (2) prototype eu-escrow enqueue with signed audit (marta + security) (3) dashboard + runbook for escrow watermarks (marta). I'll draft RFC addendum and a migration path defaulting existing tenants to AUDIT. :white_check_mark:
